result.summary:
PASS -- all 12 ACs independently re-derived and confirmed. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean. mix format --check-formatted: clean. scripts/test_parallel.sh (8 partitions, real Postgres, run by me in foreground): combined 2889 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (2893/2895 passed) -- both failures inspected directly in partition-4's log and confirmed to be Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest's rust-pin tests failing on System.cmd("rustc", ...) :enoent, the documented rustc-absent sandbox baseline, unrelated to REQ-203. Also ran test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs standalone (28/28 passed) and together with test/letflow/repository_test.exs (56/56 passed). AC1/AC2 (flagged as hardest): read the full concurrency test myself -- genuinely uses Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto), a Task.async'd activate_group/4 paused mid-Multi via test_pause_after/test_pause_fun, real resolve/3 reads from a separate connection during the pause asserting no mixed old/new state -- not vacuous. AC1's forced-failure test now correctly asserts {:error, {:validation, changeset}} with changeset.errors[:active_version_id] == {"does not exist", _}, confirmed by reading and running it, not the pre-fix raise. AC3/AC9 tenant-isolation and ON DELETE RESTRICT tests read and run directly. AC4/AC6 migration DDL read directly: UNIQUE (tenant_id, artifact_kind, artifact_name) and CHECK (rationale <> '') on both artifact_activation_groups and artifact_activation_history, confirmed enforced at the DB level by the tests (Ecto.ConstraintError / Postgrex.Error). AC5 field-by-field previous_version_id null-then-populated test read and run. AC7 all seven list_history/4 cursor-pagination tests read and run. AC8 -- independently mutation-tested by me (not only trusting the on-record TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR evidence): edited resolve/3 to fall back to latest-by-version_number, ran the two targeted tests (lines 781, 389), both failed as predicted (exit 2), reverted with git checkout, confirmed clean git status, re-ran 56/56 passed. AC10 moduledoc read directly and confirmed accurate re: activation_history vs audit_entries distinction. AC11 confirmed via git diff main...HEAD --stat (36 files, none under lib/letflow_web/). AC12 -- see compile/format/test results above, all re-run by me with real quoted output.

Two specifically-flagged contentious fixes re-verified: (1) foreign_key_constraint/3 on :active_version_id is on the single shared changeset/2 function, used by BOTH the insert and update branches of upsert_activation_pointer/8 -- confirmed by reading the source. (2) activation_test_hooks_enabled? is set to true only in config/test.exs; grepped config/dev.exs and config/prod.exs directly, neither sets it, so Application.compile_env(...) defaults to false there, making maybe_add_test_pause_step/3 a compile-time no-op outside MIX_ENV=test.

Full detail in handoffs/WF02-REQ203-20260831/release-validation-report-20260831.md.
